引爆身上的全部夜债，对周围 160 范围造成「夜债 × 70%」的伤害，然后夜债: Detonate all Night Debt: deals debt × 70% to enemies within 160, then clears the debt.
脚下的日晷按 破晓→正午→黄昏→夜 循环（每段 4 秒，命中让日晷快进）。破晓回: A sundial cycles Dawn → Noon → Dusk → Night (4 s each; hits speed it up). Dawn heals and paints wider; Noon +18% damage and stacks Glare; Dusk hits detonate Glare (9 dmg per stack, heals half); Night −15% damage, +15% speed. Each full cycle adds a Sun Ring (max 4, +4% damage and +3% max HP each).
造成的伤害另外有 35% 记成目标身上的「回响」（每人最多 120）。2.5 秒: 35% of damage dealt is also stored on the target as Echo (max 120). If you stop hitting it for 2.5 s the Echo replays as true damage (ignores shields and reductions); keep hitting to keep stacking. Kills pass half the Echo to the nearest enemy within 220. Each replay adds 1 Resonance (max 5, reset on death). Direct damage −10%.
受到的伤害 40% 先记成「夜债」，之后每秒偿还剩余的 12%（至少 4 点）。: 40% of damage taken becomes Night Debt, paid off at 12% of the remainder per second (min 4). Carrying debt raises damage (+1% per 3 debt, up to +30%). 20% of damage dealt pays debt off; takedowns clear it into a shield worth 50% of the cleared debt. Debt above your current HP is Over the limit.

6 秒内受到的伤害全部记成夜债、期间不偿还，伤害加成上限提高到 +50%；期间每: For 6 s all damage taken becomes debt with no repayment, and the damage bonus cap rises to +50%; each takedown wipes the debt. Afterwards debt repays twice as fast.
